headline: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
summary: Google's VP hinted at a price increase for the next Pixel phone. RAM supply issues due to AI data centers are a key factor. The Pixel 11 is expected to cost more than its predecessor.

headline: Synth historian Oli Freke will spend big on a good bicycle
summary: Musician and journalist Oli Freke is known for his deep dives into music technology. He's explored melodic potential and written a book on synthesizers. Freke states he'll invest significantly in a quality bicycle.

headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering offers unique grooveboxes blending synthesizers and effects pedals. These devices are known for real-time music production and eye-catching designs. A wide selection of their products is currently 30 percent off.

headline: Warner Bros. is suing Amazon for poaching employees
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has filed a lawsuit against Amazon. They accuse Amazon of illegally poaching key employees, including a senior marketing VP. Warner claims Amazon is "riding on the coattails" of Hollywood mainstays.

headline: Kevin Feige Pushes Back at Criticisms That Dr. Doom Hasn't Had Thanos-Level Buildup
summary: Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige defended Dr. Doom's potential as the next MCU big villain. Critics argued Doom lacked the extensive buildup Thanos received. Feige is pushing back against these "Doomsday critics."

headline: Winston Duke Confirms That Yes, He Really Did Improvise That Iconic Line In Black Panther
summary: Winston Duke confirmed a popular line from Black Panther was improvised. The actor made up one of the movie's funniest moments spontaneously. His off-the-cuff delivery became an iconic part of the film.

headline: 'I Would Stay at That Haunted Inn' — Widow's Bay Cast and Crew Are Just as Attached to the Island as the Rest of Us | Comic Con 2026
summary: The cast and crew of Apple TV's "Widow's Bay" appeared at Comic-Con 2026. They reacted to the show's breakout success during their Hall H panel. The team expressed their strong attachment to the show's setting, "the haunted inn."

headline: The 4 Biggest Mysteries From Marvel's Comic-Con Panel | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel Studios' Comic-Con panel left fans with major unanswered questions. Mysteries include T'Challa's adult son and Ryan Reynolds' Ghost Rider role. The article breaks down the four biggest head-scratchers from the event.

headline: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump 'if right for Britain'
summary: Prime Minister Burnham stated he would challenge US President Trump if it serves Britain's interest. He had a positive initial conversation with the US president. Burnham emphasizes defending the national interest.

headline: Andy Burnham rules out early election in exclusive BBC interview
summary: New Prime Minister Andy Burnham ruled out an early general election. He told Laura Kuenssberg he would honor the public's voted manifesto. Burnham dismissed calls for an immediate snap election.

headline: France battles fire 'whirlwinds' as another 55,000 evacuated
summary: France is combating intense wildfires, including dangerous "fire whirlwinds." An additional 55,000 people have been evacuated due to the blazes. Over 340,000 people across France and Spain have now been displaced.

headline: Iran's 'sabre-rattling' should not intimidate UK, Wes Streeting says
summary: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting stated the UK should not be intimidated by Iran's rhetoric. He warned Britain is prepared to respond to any attacks. The UK stands ready to defend itself and its allies against Iranian aggression.
